entities.summary: Anatoly Lagetko was a boxer from the Soviet Union. He was born in Tokmak, Ukrainian SSR. He competed for the Soviet Union in the 1956 Summer Olympics held in Melbourne, Australia in the lightweight event, where he finished in third place.
